summary: The WorkDecisionPort implementation for PgWorkStore: plan_decide/review_decide/repair/publication_retry/handoff_author delegate to their transaction modules; the two external-workflow operations return the documented v1 unavailable (their Python flows are grant-gated subsystems - plan-override grants and recovery policies - that belong to the v2 coordination slice with maintain_external).
responsibilities: plan_decide -> work_decision_plan::plan_decide, review_decide -> work_decision_review::review_decide, repair -> work_decision_more::repair, publication_retry -> work_decision_more::publication_retry, handoff_author -> work_decision_more::handoff_author (passing the authority through). Each first calls require_project with the request's project_alias (handoff_author reads project_alias from its command object; a command without one is rejected(400, invalid_request)).

approve_external_plan_override and recover_external_review_infrastructure: require_project, then Err(WorkError::rejected(503, "unavailable")) - the v1 boundary, recorded in forge-work-design.yaml: these flows run on the external-workflow control surface behind grant evidence the port does not carry.
invariants: The external two are the ONLY stubbed operations in the adapter, and they fail loudly with 503, never silently.
